title: dummyvar
summary: Create dummy-variable columns for grouping variables.

gpu_support.notes: GPU inputs are gathered to host. Encoding runs on CPU because it depends on class discovery and label matching.

description: `dummyvar(group)` converts grouping variables into a numeric design matrix with one dummy column per level.
behaviors: Numeric vector inputs use positive integer levels `1:max(group)`; `NaN` rows become `NaN` across that grouping variable's dummy columns.
Numeric row and column vectors are treated as one grouping variable; nonscalar numeric matrices treat each column as a separate grouping variable and concatenate the dummy columns for each variable.
Cell arrays can hold multiple grouping variables when supplied as a row cell array; cell-string vectors are encoded by first appearance.
Categorical inputs use the full category order, including categories not observed in the input values.
String, character-row, logical, and cell-string grouping variables are supported.

faqs.question: Does `dummyvar` support missing labels?
faqs.answer: Yes. Numeric `NaN`, empty text, and `<missing>` text are treated as missing; missing numeric rows produce `NaN` dummy values.
